Listen to this article Share The High Court of Lagos, in suit No. LD/0126PRA/2026, has restrained Jimmy Odukoya from parading himself as the senior pastor and spiritual head of The Fountain of Life Church. Advertisement Advertisement The Court also ordered him to refrain from interfering with the governance, administration and activities of the Church through an interim order granted to The Board of Trustees of The Fountain of Life Church on Wednesday, 18 November 2026. The Board had approached the court seeking, among other things, a pre-emptive order of injunction restraining Jimmy Odukoya, whether acting personally or through any proxies in any alleged capacity as the Senior Pastor of the Church, from interfering, disrupting, meddling with and/or obstructing the activities, governance and any other business of the Church. IT IS HEREBY ORDERED AS FOLLOWS: 1. Leave is hereby granted to the Applicant to commence this action under the Pre-Action Protocol pursuant to Paragraph 4 of the High Court of Lagos State (Expeditious Disposal of Civil Cases) Practice Direction No. 2 of 2019. 2. The Originating Processes, together with all accompanying documents, shall be served on the Respondents forthwith. Advertisement 3. The Respondents shall file their Response in accordance with the timelines stipulated under the Practice Direction. 4. This Order is made ex parte and without prejudice to the right of the Respondents to apply to set it aside, or to respond fully to the substantive claims, upon being served. Advertisement 5. That the Respondent, whether acting personally or through any proxies, is hereby restrained from holding himself out as the Senior Pastor and Spiritual Head of the Fountain of Life Church (the “Church”), having ceased to hold the office based on the appointment of a successor by the late Founder and Senior Pastor of the Church, Pastor Taiwo Odukoya, in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution of the Church pending the Applicant’s full compliance with the High Court of Lagos State (Expeditious Disposal of Civil Cases) Practice Directions No. 2 of 2019 on Pre action Protocol. 6.
